harness_at_head.exception: 1 particle(s) left the box at step 336; the case is not a free-surface standing wave any more

question: can TensorSPH carry a linear capillary standing wave, i.e. is the capillary-wave dispersion claim gradable at HEAD?

references.admissibility: Adami, Ihmsen & Adams (2012) JCP 231:7057: spurious current must stay below 10 % of the capillary velocity scale, here u_ref = A omega
references.dispersion: Lamb (1932) Art. 267/348: omega^2=(g k + sigma k^3/rho) tanh(kH), g=0 here

verdict.reason: the discrete CSF force on an open free surface injects a spurious acceleration two orders of magnitude above the wave's own restoring acceleration, so the standing wave is destroyed before one period; no variant of the solver knobs brings the spurious current inside the Adami limit
